title: Conversational Chat using Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central ( 2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Copilot as AI Companion

features.name: Copilot Conversational Chat
features.description: AI-powered conversational interface allowing Business Central users to interact with their data using natural language instead of traditional menu navigation to locate records and find answers.

features.name: Follow-up Questions and Clarification
features.description: Ability to ask follow-up questions to clarify and refine searches when initial results do not match user expectations.

features.name: Virtual Assistant for Complex Queries
features.description: Copilot acts as a virtual assistant helping users track down the right information by answering questions on how, when, or why to do things using natural language.

features.name: Learning and Onboarding Support
features.description: Copilot helps new users get up to speed quickly and enables longtime employees to learn new skills by providing answers to how to do things.

quotes.text: co-pilot is your everyday AI companion for work built on Microsoft's industry leading privacy and security
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes Copilot's positioning as a trusted AI tool with strong privacy and security foundations.

quotes.text: Business Central users are empowered to interact with their data using their own words
quotes.why_it_matters: Core capability that enables natural language interaction instead of traditional UI navigation.

quotes.text: co-pilot X as a virtual assistant helping you track down the right information at the right time all using natural language
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes Copilot's function as an intelligent assistant for information discovery.

quotes.text: new users can get up to speed quickly and longtime employees can learn new skills
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the value for both novice and experienced users in learning and productivity.

quotes.text: co-pilot helps you reclaim time so you can work work smarter adapt faster and perform better
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes key benefits of Copilot: time savings and improved work efficiency.
